description.en:
Shows a chapter title card, then fades back out.
It fades the top screen to black (CMND_BRIGHT_FADE(0, -1.0, 30.0)) and waits. It loads the background data/ep_bg.xa, the title image data/img/ep<_chapID>_<LG>.xi and the event sound ep<_chapID>_<LG>, waiting for all three.
It then shows both images (the title starting transparent) and fades in over 60 frames. After 30 more frames it plays the sound and fades the title in over 21 frames.
Once the sound has finished, it fades the screen out over 60 frames, deletes the images and closes the sound. <LG> is the language placeholder the engine fills in.
Chapter number as a two-digit string, e.g. "01".

examples.case: Title card for chapter 1 (real usage, from ev42010100.nut)
